probe_files) in models {\n145\t            let mut model_results = Vec::new();\n146\t\n147\t            for (provider, url) in probe_files {\n148\t                let result = self.probe_url(&provider, &url).await;\n149\t                model_results.push(result);\n150\t            }\n151\t\n152\t            // Sort by score (lower is better)\n153\t            model_results.sort_by(|a, b| {\n154\t                a.score.partial_cmp(&b.score).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)\n155\t            });\n156\t\n157\t            results.insert(model, model_results);\n158\t        }\n159\t\n160\t        ProviderProbeResults {\n161\t            models: results,\n162\t            timestamp,\n163\t            git_sha: Self::get_git_sha(),\n164\t        }\n165\t    }\n166\t\n167\t    /// Probe a single URL\n168\t    async fn probe_url(&mut self, provider: &str, url: &str) -> ProbeResult {\n169\t        let start = ProbeResult {\n175\t                    provider: provider.to_string(),\n176\t                    probe_url: url.to_string(),\n177\t                    connect_ms: result.connect_time.as_millis() as u64,\n178\t                    ttfb_ms: result.ttfb.as_millis() as u64,\n179\t                    throughput_mbs: result.throughput_mbs,\n180\t                    score: Self::calculate_score(&result),\n181\t                    success: true,\n182\t                    error: None,\n183\t                    timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n184\t                }\n185\t            }\n186\t            Err(e) => {\n187\t                let _elapsed = start.elapsed();\n188\t                ProbeResult {\n189\t                    provider: provider.to_string(),\n190\t                    probe_url: url.to_string(),\n191\t                    connect_ms: _elapsed.as_millis() as u64,\n192\t                    ttfb_ms: _elapsed.as_millis() as u64,\n193\t                    throughput_mbs: 0.0,\n194\t                    score: f64::MAX,\n195\t                    success: false,\n196\t                    error: Some(e.to_string()),\n197\t                    timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n198\t                }\n199\t            }\n200\t        }\n201\t    }\n202\t\n203\t    /// Inner probe logic for a single URL\n204\t    async fn probe_url_inner(&mut self, url: &str) -> Result<ProbeInnerResult, crate::FetchError> {\n205\t        let _start = std::time::Instant::now();\n206\t\n207\t        // Use the client's probe method to get basic connection info\n208\t        let probe_info = self.client.probe(url).await?;\n209\t        let connect_time = probe_info.connect_time;\n210\t\n211\t        // Check if range requests are supported\n212\t        let supports_range = probe_info.supports_range;\n213\t\n214\t        // Get content length\n215\t        let content_length = probe_info.content_length.unwrap_or(0);\n216\t\n217\t        // Now do a small range request to measure TTFB and throughput\n218\t        let range_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n219\t\n220\t        let range_response = if supports_range && content_length > 1024 {\n221\t            Some(self.client.fetch_head(url, 1024).await?)\n222\t        } else {\n223\t            None\n224\t        };\n225\t\n226\t        let ttfb = range_start.elapsed();\n227\t\n228\t        let throughput_mbs = if let Some(resp) = range_response {\n229\t            let bytes = resp.data.len() as f64;\n230\t            let seconds = ttfb.as_secs_f64();\n231\t            (bytes / seconds) / (1024.0 * 1024.0)\n232\t        } else {\n233\t            0.0\n234\t        };\n235\t\n236\t        Ok(ProbeInnerResult {\n237\t            connect_time,\n238\t            ttfb,\n239\t            throughput_mbs,\n240\t        })\n241\t    }\n242\t\n243\t    /// Calculate a combined score for provider selection\n244\t    ///\n245\t    /// Lower is better. Formula: connect_ms + ttfb_ms + (1 / throughput_mbs)\n246\t    fn calculate_score(result: &ProbeInnerResult) -> f64 {\n247\t        let connect_penalty = result.connect_time.as_millis() as f64;\n248\t        let ttfb_penalty = result.ttfb.as_millis() as f64;\n249\t        let throughput_penalty = if result.throughput_mbs > 0.0 {\n250\t            1000.0 / result.throughput_mbs\n251\t        } else {\n252\t            10000.0 // Large penalty for no throughput\n253\t        };\n254\t\n255\t        connect_penalty + ttfb_penalty + throughput_penalty\n256\t    }\n257\t\n258\t    /// Get the current git SHA for reproducibility\n259\t    fn get_git_sha() -> Option<String> {\n260\t        std::process::Command::new(\"git\")\n261\t            .args([\"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\"])\n262\t            .output()\n263\t            .ok()\n264\t            .and_then(|output| {\n265\t                let sha = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();\n266\t                if ProbeResult> {\n279\t        results.models.get(model).and_then(|model_results| {\n280\t            model_results.iter().find(|r| r.success)\n281\t        })\n282\t    }\n283\t\n284\t    /// Write chrono::Utc::now();\n302\t                let age = now.signed_duration_since(timestamp);\n303\t                age.to_std().unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO) > max_age\n304\t            }\n305\t            Err(_) => true, // Invalid timestamp means stale\n306\t        }\n307\t    }\n308\t\n309\t    /// Record a failure for the given provider\n310\t    ///\n311\t    /// Increments the consecutive failure   /// This is a convenience method that combines the staleness check with the\n341\t    /// failure tracker check. Returns true if the probe results are fresh AND\n342\t    /// no tracked providers have exceeded the consecutive failure threshold.\n343\t    ///\n344\t    /// # Arguments\n345\t    /// * `results` - The probe results to check for staleness\n346\t    /// * `max_age` - Maximum age for probe results to be considered fresh\n347\t    ///\n348\t    /// # Example\n349\t    /// ```no_run\n350\t    /// use gribtract_fetch::probe::ProviderProbe;\n351\t    /// use std::time::Duration;\n352\t    ///\n353\t    /// let probe = ProviderProbe::new();\n354\t    /// let results = ProviderProbe::load_results(std::path::Path::new(\"provider-probe.json\")).unwrap();\n355\t    ///\n356\t    /// // Check if results are valid (fresh AND no providers need re-probing)\n357\t    /// if !probe.is_valid(&results, Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600)) {\n358\t    ///     // Trigger re-probe...\n359\t    /// }\n360\t    /// ```\n361\t    pub fn is_valid(&self, results: &ProviderProbeResults, max_age: Duration) -> bool {\n362\t        // First check staleness\n363\t        if Self::is_stale(results, max_age) {\n364\t            return false;\n365\t        }\n366\t\n367\t        // Then check if any tracked provider has exceeded the failure threshold\n368\t        // Use should_reprobe() for consistency\n369\t        for provider in self.consecutive_failures.keys() {\n370\t            if self.should_reprobe(provider) {\n371\t                return false;\n372\t            }\n373\t        }\n374\t\n375\t        true\n376\t    }\n377\t\n378\t    /// Get providers that need re-probing due to consecutive failures\n379\t    ///\n380\t    /// Returns a list of provider names that have exceeded the consecutive failure threshold.\n381\t    /// This can be used to log which providers are problematic before triggering a re-probe.\n382\t    ///\n383\t    /// # Ok(_) => {\\n69\\t//!             tracker.record_success(provider);\\n70\\t//!             println!(\\\"Successfully fetched from {provider}\\\");\\n71\\t//!         }\\n72\\t//!
